account: No account required to read the guide

note: This is community documentation, not official Microsoft documentation. Corroborate claims and keep practical analysis to harmless sample binaries in a controlled lab. Useful prerequisites include executable-format basics, assembly, debugging, and static-analysis concepts.

name: SmartTube Maintainer Disclosure — Supply-Chain Security Case Study
description: Use the public project disclosure as a case study in development-environment security, release integrity, signing-key response, artifact verification, recovery, and user communication.
note: SmartTube is a media application, not a security tool. Attribute findings to the public disclosure and distinguish confirmed findings from potential impact; do not claim every build was compromised when the source does not establish that. Suggested output: an incident timeline and a release-hardening checklist.
